card.name: Serotonin in bleeding-risk warnings
card.fires_on: The word serotonin, or its ending 'otonin' after 'Ser', in NSAID and anticoagulant interaction text about bleeding. It appears in 'serotonin reuptake inhibitors' and 'Serotonin release by platelets'.

modes.label: Serotonin release by platelets
modes.description: The ending 'otonin' of Serotonin starts the sentence on platelet release, after a list of drugs that interfere with hemostasis.
modes.example: Drugs That Interfere with Hemostasis (e.g., NSAIDs, Aspirin, and Warfarin) Ser<<otonin>> release by platelets plays an important role

modes.label: Serotonin reuptake inhibitors
modes.description: The word serotonin follows a list of anticoagulants and antiplatelet agents, before reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs).
modes.example: ulation disorders, concomitant use of warfarin, other anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents (e.g., aspirin),<< serotonin>> reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs
